metadata.title: Tesla Stock Thrives on Key-Man Drama. Nvidia Might Not Be So Lucky.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Tesla Stock Thrives on Key-Man Drama. Nvidia Might Not Be So Lucky.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang finds himself in some hot water in the wake of an extramarital affair with an alleged Chinese spy that may have created conflicts of interest and compromised national security.
